funding.supported_assets_note: Unsecured US credit card (Visa Signature) repaid in USD under a Comenity Capital Bank account agreement; no crypto collateral. Rewards are paid in CRO or, since 19 May 2026 and on the cardholder's choice, in BTC, to the Crypto.com App wallet. Distinct from the Crypto.com Visa prepaid card (EEA record crypto-com-visa-card).

credit_terms.liquidation_risk: Unsecured credit card: no crypto collateral and no liquidation. Purchase and balance-transfer APR 17.74%, 25.74% or 31.74% 'based upon your creditworthiness', variable with the Prime Rate (Prime + 10.74% / 18.74% / 24.74%); cash advance APR 32.74%; penalty APR up to 39.99% after a late payment; minimum interest charge $3.00; late payment and returned payment fees up to $41 each ($30 if none in the prior six billing periods). apr_percent records the highest purchase APR of the range (Rate and Fee Summary printed November 2026).

eligibility.usage_note: Help centre: the card is 'only available to US users', 'available in US states where the Crypto.com App operates' (the linked state list was not read this run). Rewards Program Terms (as of 2 September 2025): participants must be at least 18 and must not be residents of New York. Applicants must already hold a verified Crypto.com App account; 'Credit card offers are subject to credit approval.'

kyc.thresholds_note: No thresholds: a verified Crypto.com App account (app onboarding / KYC) is a precondition, then a credit application.
kyc.stages_note: 1) Sign up for the Crypto.com App and 'complete the onboarding process' (KYC verification article linked, not read this run). 2) Pre-qualification with a soft inquiry that 'will not affect your credit score'. 3) Application requiring 'a complete and accurate name, address, date of birth and social security number' and 'a credit check and approval'. Physical card shipped within 14 business days; virtual card usable in Apple Wallet / Google Wallet before delivery.

editorial.summary: US-only unsecured Visa Signature credit card issued by Comenity Capital Bank (Bread Financial) for Crypto.com: no annual fee, 3% foreign transaction fee, purchase APR 17.74%–31.74% variable. Rewards follow the Level Up tier — 1.5% (free) to 6% (US$500,000 CRO lock-up) — paid in CRO without a cap, or in BTC up to a monthly spend cap ($250 to $10,000) then 1–2%. Paid tiers cost $4.99 or $29.99 a month (or a CRO lock-up).
good_for: US residents (outside New York) who already use the Crypto.com App and want crypto rewards on a credit card without collateral
Spenders who stay within the BTC monthly caps, or who prefer uncapped CRO rewards
Travellers interested in Priority Pass access (Pro and Private tiers)
not_for: Anyone outside the United States — the card is 'only available to US users'
Spending abroad: 3% foreign transaction fee on every non-USD transaction
Carrying a balance: APR up to 31.74% (penalty APR up to 39.99%) would outweigh any reward
Cash withdrawals: cash advances cost $10 or 5% plus 32.74% APR from day one
watch_outs: Rewards above the free tier require a paid Level Up subscription ($4.99 or $29.99/month) or a 12-month CRO lock-up ($500 to $500,000) — the subscription is a cost the calculator deducts; the lock-up exposes you to CRO price risk.
CRO rewards are uncapped but paid in Crypto.com's own token; BTC rewards are capped at $250–$10,000 of monthly spend, then 1–2%.

Pricing pages disagree on small points (Plus yearly $49.90 vs $49.99; headline 4.5% / 6% / 6.5%) and advertise welcome bonuses ($100–$300 in CRO) without dated terms — none of these promotions is modelled.
The state availability list and the Crypto.com KYC article were not read this run; a credit check (soft pre-qualification, then full application with SSN) is required.
Rewards 'may take up to two billing cycles' to confirm; refunds claw back rewards in the token received.
